title: On Quoting the very words of the contract
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：quote　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 quote 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the cook ① quoted the very words of the contract in silence, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② quotes the very words of the contract twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ quote the very words of the contract at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ quoted the very words of the contract before — a line in the menu for September 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Quoting the very words of the contract in silence, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ quote two hundred pounds for the work twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Quote two hundred pounds for the work at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ quotes two hundred pounds for the work in silence every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ quoted the very words of the contract again when nobody else would.

⑩ To quote the very words of the contract, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody quotes the very words of the contract twice over again and somebody must quote the very words of the contract in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 引用（一般过去式 quoted the very words of the contract：1970 年厨子头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 引用（一般现在 quotes the very words of the contract：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 引用（不定式 to quote the very words of the contract：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 引用（过去完成时 had quoted the very words of the contract：1964 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 引用（动名词 quoting the very words of the contract 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 报价（quote two hundred pounds for the work：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去报价为这件活开价两百镑）
G. v. 报价（quote two hundred pounds for the work：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 引用（后段两处：新来的客人照例 quotes two hundred pounds for the work，而母亲又一次 quoted the very words of the contract）

answers.why: quote 意为“引用”，1970 年厨子一言不发地引用引用合约里的原话，那是食堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 quoted。
quote 意为“引用”，自那以后厨子来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 quotes。
quote 意为“引用”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯引用引用合约里的原话”，此处为不定式 to quote the very words of the contract。
quote 意为“引用”，菜单里 九月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人引用过，故用过去完成时 had quoted。
quote 意为“引用”，厨子说“引用引用合约里的原话这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 quoting the very words of the contract 作主语。
quote 意为“报价”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去报价为这件活开价两百镑”，should ever 之后用原形 quote two hundred pounds for the work。
quote 意为“报价”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻报价为这件活开价两百镑（quote two hundred pounds for the work at once），以后再也不要提起。
quote 意为“引用”，新来的客人每个日子都照例报价为这件活开价两百镑，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 quotes。
quote 意为“引用”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地引用引用合约里的原话，用一般过去式 quoted 叙述。
quote 意为“引用”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要引用引用合约里的原话，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 quote 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the cook quoted the very words of the contract in silence, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook quotes the very words of the contract twice over whenever the canteen asks.
Quoting the very words of the contract in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever quote two hundred pounds for the work twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen quotes two hundred pounds for the work in silence every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother quoted the very words of the contract again, and the canteen remembered that half.
